purpose: Teach: 大尉/同書/号証/線形/密集/細心/デモンストレーション/もとづく
target_vocab: デモンストレーション

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業者は元自衛隊の大尉でいらした
lines.en: Our founder was a former Self-Defense Force captain.
lines.style: Measured, factual statement. Brief pause after 'founder,' letting the detail land. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who knows this will be relevant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。提案書では同書の参考文献を明示します
lines.en: Yes. We'll make the reference sources explicit in the proposal.
lines.style: Attentive and professional. Direct, no filler. Quick nod in the voice—accepting the instruction and already mentally moving to execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、訴訟資料の甲第一号証を提出しろ
lines.en: Submit the first piece of litigation evidence for the company.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Slight emphasis on 'first'—this matters in sequence. No question in the tone. An order, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業計画の線形成長予測を立てます
lines.en: Yes. We'll establish a linear growth projection in the business plan.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Businesslike pace. The voice of someone taking notes mentally while speaking—absorbing the requirement and confirming receipt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 密集した展示会場にも対応しろ
lines.en: Make sure it works even in crowded exhibition spaces.
lines.style: Brief, pragmatic. A specific constraint stated without elaboration. The tone assumes he understands why this matters without needing it explained.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。細心の注意を払って準備します
lines.en: Yes. We'll prepare with careful attention to detail.
lines.style: Assured and conscientious. Slight warmth beneath the formality—not just compliance, but genuine care in the preparation. Even pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 展示会でデモンストレーションを実施しろ
lines.en: Run a live demonstration at the exhibition.
lines.style: Clear instruction, slightly elevated importance. A beat before 'demonstration'—this is the key action. Calm but present.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営判断は事実にもとづく方針です
lines.en: Yes. Our policy is that management decisions are grounded in fact.
lines.style: Formal, measured closing. A slight gravitas on 'fact'—not defending, but affirming a principle. The tone of someone making a statement of record.
